title: Doctors great getting an appointment not good.
content: The Dr was really helpful, he was very unhurried which I really appreciated as I’m certain he was under huge time pressure. He listened attentively ,gave good advice explaining his reasoning and giving me options. I felt that I had choices about my treatment and excellent professional advice to help me exercise those choices. Thanks.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
